//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the KPI COMPARISON-GAUGES CONTAINER — the `.pa-kpi-gauge-list` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiGaugeList.kpi_gauge_list/1`, svelte `display/KpiGaugeList.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. This is a CARD-based container (`.pa-card.pa-kpi-gauge-list`) with a shared KPI header (`.pa-card__header.pa-kpi-header` + optional `.pa-kpi-live` LIVE pill), a zero-padding body (`.pa-card__body.pa-kpi-gauge-list__body`) holding the gauge GRID (`.pa-kpi-gauge-list__grid` + its column-cap/2col `__grid--*` modifiers + an inline `--pa-kpi-gauge-cell-min` density override), and an optional footer (`.pa-card__footer.pa-kpi-footer`). The grid's gauge TILES come from a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte KpiGauge.svelte, keen kpi_gauge/1) fed through the default slot, which BOTH dumpers pass as plain ESCAPED TEXT — so real tile markup can't materialize. This fixture proves ONLY what the container emits: the card shell, the header/live/footer slots, the body, the grid element + its column-cap modifiers + the cell-min inline style, and the class passthrough. The per-GAUGE element classes (pa-kpi-gauge / __head / __label / __value / __num / __unit / __bar / __fill / __scale and the --positive/--warning/--negative/--neutral sentiment modifiers) belong to the deferred gauge sub-component and are acknowledged as prose in `deferred` (no gauge fragment fixture/dumper clause exists to fixture-ref). See kpi-editorial.json / kpi-bento.json for the same container-only model (container element-modifiers claimed via features, child-component element classes deferred). The shared pa-kpi-header / pa-kpi-live / pa-kpi-footer classes are NOT pa-kpi-gauge-list__* (different block, shared KPI chrome) so axis-1's element reverse-check doesn't touch them; they still appear verbatim in the goldens.

inside .pa-card__header.pa-kpi-header. svelte `titleText`, keen `title_text`. When absent AND not live, the whole header is omitted.
propsVocabulary.live: show the LIVE pill (animated dot + 'LIVE') next to the title (.pa-kpi-live > .pa-kpi-live__dot). svelte `isLive` bool (label is the hardcoded literal 'LIVE'); keen `is_live` bool with `live_text` defaulting to 'LIVE'. The header renders if titleText OR live is set.
propsVocabulary.footerText:
footer caption text — rendered as
…
. svelte `footerText`, keen `footer_text`. When absent (and no footer slot), the footer is omitted.
propsVocabulary.gridLayout: grid column modifier on the grid element — one of 2col / max-2 / max-3 / max-4 / max-5 / max-6, emitting pa-kpi-gauge-list__grid--{value}. Default (nil) is the bare cell-min-driven auto-fit grid, no modifier. 2col forces exactly 2 columns; max-N caps the auto-fit column count at N. svelte `gridLayout` (dash-cased token), keen `grid_layout` (underscored token max_N, dasherized to the CSS class; 2col passes through unchanged).
propsVocabulary.cellMinWidth: CSS length written as the inline style `--pa-kpi-gauge-cell-min: {value};` on the grid element (density override; upstream default 20rem). svelte `cellMinWidth`, keen `cell_min_width`. Inline style, not a class.
propsVocabulary.body: the grid's tile area — plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-kpi-gauge children are the deferred sub-component). svelte `children`, keen `inner_block` (required:true).
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the card (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural container only. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the card shell + header/footer slots + the grid element (class/modifier/inline-style) + nesting, not rich gauge content. The header is emitted ONLY when titleText or live is set; the footer ONLY when footerText (or a footer slot) is set — scenarios exercise both the present and absent forms. The cell-min inline style lands on the GRID element as style="--pa-kpi-gauge-cell-min: {value};"; both wrappers serialize it identically (keen `#{width};` / svelte `${width};`). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-gauge-list'). The .pa-kpi-gauge-list BLOCK has ZERO block-level modifiers (no pa-kpi-gauge-list--* exists — the column caps/2col are ELEMENT modifiers on __grid, and the sentiment tints are modifiers on the deferred gauge tile). So axis-1's block-modifier reverse check is vacuous for this block. CONTAINER element classes: __body (always on the card body) and __grid (+ its 2col / max-2..max-6 __grid--* caps) are produced/exercised here; __body & __grid appear in every golden, the caps are produced by the gridLayout enum template. GAUGE element classes (pa-kpi-gauge/__head/__label/__value/__num/__unit/__bar/__fill/__scale[/--*]) are the deferred sub-component (prose in `deferred`) — note the gauge tile is the hyphen-joined block `pa-kpi-gauge`, NOT a `pa-kpi-gauge-list__gauge` element, so axis-1's pa-kpi-gauge-list__* reverse-check does not even see it. `produces: null` = structural/native/inline-style (no class).

live.note: LIVE pill (.pa-kpi-live, shared KPI chrome — not a pa-kpi-gauge-list__* class); structural

footerText.note: footer caption; absence omits the footer — structural, no class

gridLayout.note: column modifier on __grid; default (nil) is the bare auto-fit grid. 2col = exactly 2 cols; max-N = cap auto-fit at N

cellMinWidth.note: inline style --pa-kpi-gauge-cell-min on the grid element; density override, not a class

body.note: structural — the grid's inner content; real gauges are the deferred sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the card, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-GAUGE element + state classes of the comparison-gauges design — NOT container markup. They are emitted by the SEPARATE gauge sub-component (svelte KpiGauge.svelte, keen kpi_gauge/1) fed through the default slot, which both dumpers pass as plain escaped TEXT, so they cannot materialize in THIS container slice. They are now covered by the dedicated kpi-gauge FRAGMENT fixture (svelte KpiGauge, keen kpi_gauge/1) and are fixture-ref'd here — capability VERIFIES each ref actually produces/renders the class in kpi-gauge.json. The gauge tile is its own hyphen-joined block (pa-kpi-gauge), not a pa-kpi-gauge-list__* element, so capability axis-1's element reverse-check does not catch it; the fixture-ref is the verifier. The --positive/--warning/--negative/--neutral modifiers set the fill colour via --pa-kpi-bar-color. The bar fill width and the target-tick position (--pa-kpi-gauge-tick-pos) are inline per-tile styles, exercised in the kpi-gauge fragment scenarios.
